title: Borland's alleged classified ICIG drawing of a pyramid-shaped power source
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of Borland's alleged classified ICIG drawing of a pyramid-shaped power source, about recent (2020s) at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: agency, they said he drew, obviously, the triangle that he saw or whatever, but in the ICIG that he drew a pyramid-shaped power source.

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who makes UFO documentaries, said on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2026 that a witness named Dylan Borland gave secret testimony to the ICIG, the internal watchdog that takes complaints from US intelligence workers. Corbell says he was told that Borland drew the triangle-shaped craft he saw, and also drew a pyramid-shaped power source. If true, it would point to the government knowing how such a craft is powered.
